meta.title: Competitor Radar
meta.niche: AI talent agents and job-search tools that help startup job seekers get hired (matching, introductions to hiring managers, auto-apply)

analysis.summary: Most rivals publish little new content. JobCopilot is the most active, with how-tos and lists for broad job seekers, while Jack & Jill uses case studies aimed at hiring teams.

points.text: JobCopilot published 4 new pages and updated 2, mostly how-tos for general job seekers, not startup-focused.
Jack & Jill shows buyer-facing proof with 2 new case studies, including one on how Attio reaches engineers.
Clera has 12 pages and no activity in 30 days, while Jack & Jill has 443 pages and WonsultingAI 383.

Jack & Jill.play: Case studies on two-sided AI hiring, plus 357 company pages for scale.

Wellfound.play: One new blog hub page on startup jobs, hiring and AI recruiting tools.

Jobright AI.play: No new or updated pages in the last 30 days.

JobCopilot.play: Auto-apply how-tos, tool lists and a review, with two refreshed pages.

WonsultingAI.play: Career advice and a results story, backed by 144 job-search hub pages.
WonsultingAI.aimed: Job seekers learning and early buyers

Clera.play: No activity in the last 30 days and only 12 pages.

shared.title: Proof stories
shared.text: Jack & Jill and WonsultingAI each published a case study of results. Both show outcomes, such as replies from engineers or interviews won, to build trust before buying.

shared.title: Big templated sections
shared.text: Jack & Jill (357 company pages) and WonsultingAI (144 hub pages) use templated pages to build size. Clera can't match that count soon, so it needs sharper content.

gaps.title: Startup-only auto-apply safety
gaps.text: JobCopilot covers safe auto-apply for everyone. Nobody covers it for startup roles, where founders and small teams read applications differently.

gaps.title: Candidate-side case studies
gaps.text: Jack & Jill's case study is for hiring teams, and Wonsulting's is a single newsletter story. Clera could publish startup hires from intro to offer.

gaps.title: Honest AI job tool comparisons
gaps.text: Only JobCopilot has a tools list and a review, and it's a vendor ranking itself. A startup-focused comparison that includes Clera is open.

versus.Jack & Jill: Far larger and active, with buyer case studies. Clera has no recent output to match it.
versus.Wellfound: Publishes a broad startup blog with one new page. Clera has not published in 30 days.
versus.Jobright AI: Also quiet, with 61 pages and no recent activity, so Clera isn't behind it on pace.
versus.JobCopilot: Publishes and refreshes pages steadily for broad job seekers. Clera has published nothing in the same period.
versus.WonsultingAI: Mixes career advice with a results story and a large hub. Clera has far fewer pages and no new ones.
